form.name: Name
form.keyKeep: Leave blank to keep the current key

hint.openai: OpenAI-compatible: any server that speaks /v1/chat/completions, a gateway included.
hint.deepseek: DeepSeek: the native chat-completions API, with its thinking switch handled for you. Leave the base URL blank to use api.deepseek.com; a gateway in front of DeepSeek takes its own address.
hint.anthropic: Anthropic (Claude): the native Messages API. A gateway that routes Claude only there needs its own address (what comes before /v1/messages) and a model id as that gateway lists it.
hint.responses: OpenAI (Responses API): posts to /responses instead of /chat/completions, for a deployment or gateway that serves a model there (e.g. MIOFFICE azure_openai/gpt-5.6-sol). The base URL is what comes before /responses.

note.persistent: Provider settings are saved in history.
note.volatile: Provider settings are kept until this node stops.

error.required: A name and a model are both required.
error.baseUrl: The base URL starts with http:// or https://.
error.selectFirst: Save or select a provider first.

test.empty: Provider call succeeded (empty reply).{usage} Tested “{name}” with its saved config.
